title: Dispersion and Scattering of Light
summary: Prisms and spectra, rainbows, twinkling stars, the blue sky and red sunsets.

cbse.chapter: The Human Eye and the Colourful World

objectives: I can explain dispersion by a prism.
I can explain how rainbows form.
I can explain the blue sky, red sunsets and the Tyndall effect.
misconceptions: The prism adds colour to white light.
The sky is blue because it reflects the sea.
